results.title: Continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT): Consider delayed administration of concurrent echinocandins, such as caspofungin, to reduce the risk of adsorption onto new polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based filter membranes DSI/2026/014
results.description: Continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) is used for managing severe acute kidney injury and fluid overload. Published evidence has shown that caspofungin can bind to polyacrylonitrile (PAN)-based membranes used in CRRT which may result in ineffective antifungal treatment.

results.description: Norgine Pharmaceuticals Limited is recalling the batches listed in the table due to risk of particulate matter being present in the product identified during routine stability investigations.

results.title: Intra-oral dental X-ray units: IRIX 70, IRIX 708, Oramatic 558 or Novelix 6510 – wall mount bracket may fail
results.description: (Trophy (now owned by Carestream Health)) Risk of injury from falling unit after failure of the wall mount bracket. (MDA/2013/053)

results.title: Antidepressants: new safety measures for all patients to improve communication of the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviours and persistent sexual dysfunction
results.description: New safety measures are now being implemented to improve how the risks of suicidal thoughts and behaviours and persistent sexual dysfunction are communicated to patients taking antidepressant medications.

results.title: Aspirin: not licensed for primary prevention of thrombotic vascular disease
results.description: In the UK, low-dose aspirin is licensed for prevention of thrombotic cerebrovascular or cardiovascular disease only in those who already have vascular disease—ie, secondary prevention.
